shell.//: init_hook surfaces `node` on PATH from the aws-cdk-cli closure. jsii (which aws_cdk / constructs drive on import) needs a bare `node`, but devbox does not expose one even though the pinned aws-cdk-cli bundles nodejs in its closure. Steering says node must come from that closure, not a separate `nodejs` package, so we derive node's bin dir from the `cdk` launcher's shebang (dynamic, so it tracks aws-cdk-cli upgrades rather than pinning a brittle /nix/store path) and prepend it. Fixes `cdk synth`, `just synth`, and the offline CDK assertion tests (`import aws_cdk`) for every recipe and `uv run`.
init_hook: if command -v cdk >/dev/null 2>&1; then _cdk_node_bin=$(dirname "$(sed -n '1s/^#!//p' "$(readlink -f "$(command -v cdk)")")"); case ":$PATH:" in *":$_cdk_node_bin:"*) ;; *) export PATH="$_cdk_node_bin:$PATH" ;; esac; unset _cdk_node_bin; fi
